basePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE Minecraft Create creative-inventory category banner texture. Generate a SINGLE extremely wide horizontal strip, exactly 162 pixels wide by 18 pixels tall (9:1 aspect). If upscaled, use nearest-neighbor integer pixel enlargement only. Edge-to-edge pixel art scene, no surrounding blank canvas, no margin, no mockup, no text, no lettering, no logos. Hand-placed crisp square pixels, limited 12-24 color palette, native Minecraft/Create pixel density, no anti-alias, no smooth gradients, no photorealism. Like a tiny richly illustrated panoramic pixel-art inventory header: subdued textured scene on the left 55% so runtime title can be readable there; strongest recognizable subject artwork across the right half; artwork spans full banner height. 1 pixel dark charcoal border with small top edge highlight, no generic metal plate overlay, no repeated icon pasted on flat color. GEOMETRY: use a logical canvas 162 pixels wide by 54 pixels high. Its top 18 rows and bottom 18 rows are SOLID BLACK letterboxing. Paint the entire single banner exclusively inside the MIDDLE 18 ROWS, from y=18 to y=35. This makes the visible artwork EXACTLY 9:1. No artwork outside this 162-by-18 center stripe. Use tiny native square pixels; do not make a tall illustration and squash it. Specific category scene:
